sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', c.date)::date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'HOBBIES_2_140' AND s.state_id = 'WI' GROUP BY ds ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the total sales (y) for product HOBBIES_2_140 in state WI, aggregated quarterly (quarter granularity), using the calendar date as the time index (ds).
